messages:
lina: heads-up — onboarding ptq-slimV1 to canary; small but reproducible uptick in funcall parse errors on streaming tool responses.

devon: streaming-only? sample please.

lina: yes. mirrored traffic -> canary. sample chunk pair (proxy raw):
```
{"delta":"...\u00ff","finish_reason":null}
{"delta":"\"}\n","finish_reason":"stop"}
```
When concatenated yields '...\u00ff\"}\n' which sometimes leads to JSON decode errors.

maria: 0xff is odd; could be signed/unsigned byte from tokenizer output after quantization. Any difference vs FP32?

kai: suggestion: run quant-replay: same batching and prefix-cache on FP32 and PTQ; capture token byte boundaries. If FP32 clean and PTQ noisy, quantizer likely introduced byte compaction.

lina: doing 2k trace replay now. Also opening INF-4500.

eval-bot: telemetry: parse_error_rate(ptq-slimv1:canary)=0.014 over 3h; baseline(raven-v2-q8)=0.0003. top routes: tool-invoke.

devon: temp mitigations: 1) enable per-chunk sanitizer that strips isolated high-byte control chars before final parse; 2) disable kv-prefix compacting for canary; 3) add hex-dump sampling. Which order?

maria: prefer 2 then 3 then 1 as last resort. Sanitizer can hide root cause. But flip 2 quickly to reduce user impact.

kai: I'll add hex sampling and run FP32 vs PTQ token stream diff. If quantizer is compressing bytes into 0xff markers we need to fix packer.

lina: disabled kv-prefix compaction at 1867005620. immediate drop in smoke slice. replay in progress, ETA 30m.

maria: keep INF-4500 updated. if sanitizer needed temporarily, ensure logs include raw bytes stored in S3.

lina: update 1867006310: replay complete; disabling compaction reduced failures by 92% on failing set. attaching diffs to INF-4500. Next: patch quantizer and add unit test for token-byte invariants.
